headline: Lukoil Petrotel Refinery in Romania Prepares to Resume Operations
summary: Russian energy company Lukoil is preparing its Petrotel oil refinery in Ploiesti, Romania, to resume fuel production activities following operational suspensions.
why: The Petrotel refinery is one of Romania's largest fuel production plants, serving Southeastern European market demand.

impacts.name: Lukoil Petrotel Refinery
impacts.why: Resuming operations restores refining throughput for the regional facility.
